stem: What is the most likely reason the poet includes this imagery?
instruction:
Read lines 6 and 7.

She holds a furry ball with paws—
A baby squirrel just half her size

options.label: A
options.text: To show that the baby squirrel will grow to look like its mother

options.label: B
options.text: To suggest that the baby squirrel is sick

options.label: C
options.text: To suggest that the baby squirrel is small and helpless

options.label: D
options.text: To show that the baby squirrel likes to play games
